items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_aura.de: Empower your attacks with many elemental aura.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_barrier: Coat the caster with a Magic Barrier with the strength based on Health.
Gather your aura into a powerful blast.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_darknes: Gain access to the intermediate Darkness Spirit Magic and boost your darkness attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_earth_t: Gain access to the intermediate Earth Spirit Magic and boost your earth attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_flame_t: Gain access to the intermediate Flame Spirit Magic and boost your fire attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_jamming: Interferes with skills, magics, flight and transformation with mastery.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_light_t: Gain access to the intermediate Light Spirit Magic and boost your light attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_resista: Ignore weaker magical attacks or reduce the damage from stronger spells.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_sense.d: Using magicule to sense entities around.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_space_t: Gain access to the intermediate Space Spirit Magic and boost your spatial attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_wall.de: Generate a magic wall to protect the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_water_t: Gain access to the intermediate Water Spirit Magic and boost your water attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magic_wind_tr: Gain access to the intermediate Wind Spirit Magic and boost your wind attacks while buffing yourself and debuffing enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.magma_surge.d: Fire a spread of lava that burns and melts anything for a limited time.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.majesty.descr: By boosting your reputation with the villagers, gain a permanent Hero of the Village effect.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mana_manipula: Grant better control on Mana with less magicule cost on casted Magics and less damage taken from magicule-based attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.martial_maste: Empower your physical attacks, accelerate your thought process to react and dodge better while beating your enemies to submission.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mathematician: Use mathematics to improve your combat abilities, become able to use analytical appraisal to assess all.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.maximum_magic: Gather your aura into a gargantuan blast obliterating all who dare oppose you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.megiddo.descr: Unleash powerful sun blasts using water to kill any nearby foes. It can also be used manually to concentrate fire for any stronger foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.merciless.des: Instantly kill weakened enemies or drain the life force of those who lack the will to fight or of those much weaker than you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mirage.descri: Create illusionary clones around the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.molecular_man: Use your intricate knowledge and power over the building blocks of the world to obtain blocks and move entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mortal_fear.d: Inspire a gripping fear of death in weaker enemies while empowering your allies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mud_hand.desc: Bind targets with several hands of mud.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.mud_spears.de: Raise mud spikes from the ground to pierce through your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.multilayer_ba: Protect yourself with a multitude of powerful defensive barriers.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.murderer.desc: Disappear into the shadows and deal massive damage, also become undetectable by sound.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.musician.desc: Turn beautiful music into an instrument of destruction. Use sound to create powerful blasts which ignore armor.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.observer.desc: See all, evade all. Instinctively avoid attacks, detect concealed dangers, and identify hidden entities. Nothing escapes your watchful gaze.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_berserke: Allow rage to consume you to massively improve your physical powers for a time before the aftereffects set in.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_flame.de: Use your aura to create a pillar of fire.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ogre_sword_ca: Condense your aura into a blade projectile.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.oppressor.des: Dominate gravity yourself, control attractive and repulsive forces or unleash devastating ranged attacks which will crush anyone unfortunate enough to be in your path.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.paralysing_br: Spew a horrifying breath to paralyze your prey.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.paralysis.des: Empower your attacks with the effect of Paralysis, toggleable when mastered.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.paralysis_res: Ignore weaker paralysis effects or reduce the duration of stronger paralysis.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.physical_atta: Ignore weaker physical attacks or reduce the damage from stronger blows.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.pierce_resist: Ignore weaker piercing damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.poison.descri: Empower your attacks with the effect of Poison, toggleable when mastered.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.poison_resist: Ignore weaker poisons or reduce the damage from more potent toxins.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.poisonous_bre: Use your disgusting breath to corrode and nauseate your targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.possession.de: Possess a weakened material body to gain access to a whole new world.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.possession_ma: Possess a weakened material body to gain a new powers from that body.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.predator.desc: Become the monster you were meant to be. Eat all. Analyze, craft and refine items, gain access to a spatial storage and mimic entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.pride.descrip: Turn the strength of your opponents into your own and turn the tides of battle. Copy abilities when you are struck by them, provided you meet the necessary conditions.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ranged_barrie: Place down differently sized barriers which block enemies in or out. Strong attacks can still destroy them.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reaper.descri: Do recon by becoming smaller and more agile while seeing all enemies nearby. Spawn clones, or consume the essence of your enemies to obliterate them in a single strike.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.recovery.desc: Greatly recover a living being's health as well as food points.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reflector.des: Turn back the tides of battle by reflecting all of the received damage. Unleash a devastating projectile attack or counter an attack directly.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reincarnation: Sacrifice a portion of the caster's power to reincarnate.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reinforced_ba: Coat the caster with reinforced Barriers with the strength based on Health.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reinforcement: Greatly enhance the caster's gears durability.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.researcher.de: Study ancient magic tomes, reverse engineer them, and create wonders beyond imagination.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reverser.desc: Flip the rules. Change alignments, invert buffs and debuffs while shifting strengths and weaknesses to your benefit.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.roaring_lion_: Focus your aura into a fearsome blow with the regalness of a lion.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.royal_beast.d: Unleash a primal fury and gain a massive physical boost to crush your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sacred_haki.d: Strike fear into the hearts of evil and give strength to your allies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sage.descript: Increase the speed at which you learn and master skills, magic and arts.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.scale_armor.d: Like the lizardmen, move through water and mud with no penalties while receiving a slight defense buff.
Highlight hostile mobs around the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.seeker.descri: Accelerate thought processing to extreme levels, mastery over magics and manipulate the fundamental laws governing the world to optimize actions and outcomes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.seer.descript: See everything. Foresee your opponent’s moves. Dodge or mitigate their attacks and predict their movement to score critical strikes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.self_regenera: Speed up your body’s natural regeneration to increase your survivability.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sense_heat_so: Highlights entities that generate heat nearby.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sense_soundwa: Empower your ears to precisely locate any nearby entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.severer.descr: Slice through reality and manifest spatial blades which cut through armor and unleash devastating blade storms.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shadow_bind.d: If the target is standing in shadows, bind them and deal spiritual damage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shadow_motion: Melt into the shadows and move unseen by all but the most keen observers.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shadow_strike: Become one with the shadows and deal massive spiritual damage and become immune to lesser presence detection.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shrink.descri: Reduce your size to enhance your evasion but increase your vulnerability
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sleep_mist.de: Release a wide area of sleeping mist to paralyze targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sloth.descrip: Grind the world to a halt. Put your enemies into a deadly sleep, drain their power and rest to regain any lost vitality. May lethargy take over.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.snake_eye.des: Apply various debuff on targets on sight.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sniper.descri: Deal damage from afar while using different bullets to get past resistances and ensure a quick kill.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_beam.de: Fire a light beam that deals massive damage to undead entities and burns blocks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_flare.d: Shoot a shockwave of light energy to give nausea, blindness and slowness to all targets in a wide AOE.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_rain.de: Shoot many light projectiles that deal massive damage to undead creatures.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_wave.de: Shoot a wave of light energy that blinds and slows hit enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sound_dominat: Boosts Sound abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sound_manipul: Boosts Sound abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.space.descrip: Form invisible platforms to create footholds midair.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.space_transfo: Channel the powers of space to weaken and damage all nearby entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_attac: Ignore weaker spatial attacks or reduce the damage from stronger dimensional strikes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_domin: Boosts Space abilities by a large amount and deals massive damage by splitting a target with dimensional attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_manip: Boosts Space abilities by a decent amount and manipulate space to empower your ranged attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_motio: Tear space asunder granting yourself and your allies safe passage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_stora: Rift space to create a small pocket dimension to store items.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spearhead.des: Empower and command your allies, and then collect their abilities once they pass on.
